name: publisher-content-discovery-widget
description: Reusable multi-publisher AI-ready content discovery widget foundation.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.widget.config.ts && vite build --config vite.server.config.ts
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run scan:secrets && node scripts/release-check.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run scan:secrets
